full_prompt_en: A square whimsical science-fiction illustration shows a small screen-headed robot standing on a patch of grass against a pale yellow-green background. The figure is centered with broad empty space on both sides, its short body visible from head to heavy boots. A mustard-yellow triangular hood rises above its square monitor face, fitted with little blue lenses, bolts, and thin antennae that jut at uneven angles. The monitor glows a muted blue-green, with fine static-like texture and no recognizable expression. Metal discs, wires, and small fittings cluster around its head and neck. A worn red jacket hangs open over an off-white shirt, with circular patches on the sleeves and a few dangling cords at the chest. Below, baggy dark teal shorts are cinched with a mechanical belt of round brass-and-steel components. Both arms are articulated from exposed machinery, one hanging beside the body and the other holding the handle of a small gray radio set on the ground to the right. The radio has a rectangular front panel and small knobs, but no readable letters. Brown segmented legs end in scuffed boots planted among narrow blades of green grass. Soft diffuse light from the upper left catches the yellow hood, red cloth, and metal edges, while gentle shadows collect below the feet and between mechanical layers. Fine drawn contours and tiny weathering marks describe the hardware, while the background remains a smooth muted field. The overall composition is playful and self-contained, balancing a richly textured invented figure against generous quiet negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇趣科幻插图呈现一名屏幕头小机器人，站在浅黄绿色背景前的一小片草地上。人物居中，两侧留有宽阔空区，从头到厚靴完整可见。芥末黄色三角头罩高过方形显示器脸，上面装着小蓝镜片、螺栓和朝不同方向伸出的细天线。显示器发出暗蓝绿色光，带细微静电般肌理，没有可辨表情。金属圆盘、电线和小配件聚在头颈周围。磨旧红外套敞在灰白衬衫外，袖上有圆形贴章，胸前垂着几条线缆。下面，宽松深青色短裤由一条带黄铜与钢色圆形构件的机械腰带束住。双臂由裸露机械关节组成，一只垂在身旁，另一只握着右侧地面上小灰收音机的提手。收音机前面有矩形面板和小旋钮，但没有可读字母。棕色分节双腿踩着磨损靴子，立在细窄绿草中。柔和漫射光从左上照来，落在黄头罩、红布料和金属边缘，脚下与机械层间聚起轻柔阴影。细描线与小型风化痕迹刻画硬件，背景则保持平顺暗淡色场。整体构图俏皮而自足，以肌理丰富的想象形体平衡宽裕安静留白。
style_prompt_en: The illustration combines crisp small mechanical linework with softly weathered painted color. Muted mustard, rusty red, blue-green, brass, and warm cream form a friendly retro palette; small cool luminous areas focus attention. Compact layered components are outlined precisely, while cloth and organic edges carry looser texture. Diffuse light picks out raised metal and fabric surfaces without dramatic shadows. The subject mass remains centered and richly detailed against a broad nearly uniform ground, so complexity is concentrated rather than spread everywhere. Fine scratches, scuffs, and uneven color prevent the technology from looking new or sterile. The overall effect is playful, nostalgic, and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅插图把清楚的小型机械线稿与柔和风化的绘画色彩结合。暗芥末黄、锈红、蓝绿、黄铜色和暖奶油色组成亲切的复古配色；小面积冷色发光集中注意力。紧凑层叠的部件有精确轮廓，布料和有机边缘则带更松散的肌理。漫射光挑亮隆起的金属与织物表面，没有戏剧性深影。主体体块居中、细节丰富，背景是一片宽阔近乎均匀的色场，因此复杂性集中而非铺满各处。细刮痕、擦损和不均匀色彩让科技物件不显得全新或无菌。整体效果俏皮、怀旧而可触。
theme_en: A small screen-headed robot standing in grass with an old radio
theme_zh: 站在草地中、手持旧收音机的小型屏幕头机器人
name: _.hackSign
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
